_chunk.purpose: Canonical object visual descriptions for prop generation and scene composition

_schema.description: Detailed object specifications for consistent asset generation
_schema.usage: Objects are composited into scenes. Each object can be generated separately and placed.

holographic_arm.name: Holographic Arm Mk.III

description.overview: Full arm prosthetic replacement from shoulder to fingertips. Semi-transparent cyan holographic shell with visible internal tech.
description.purpose: Combat, hacking, enhanced grip, built-in scanner

material.internals: Visible mechanical components - servo motors, power conduits, data cables

dimensions.length: Shoulder to fingertip, same as natural arm

texture.outer: Smooth energy field with slight flicker at edges
texture.inner: High-detail mechanical - visible gears, cables, circuits

effects.idle: Subtle pulse of light along energy lines
effects.combat: Energy concentrates at hand, shield-like barrier possible

views_needed.description: Full arm from shoulder to fingers, side view
Close-up of hand showing finger articulation

holographic_arm.generation_prompt: Cyberpunk holographic prosthetic arm: Semi-transparent cyan energy shell with visible internal mechanics. Servo motors, power conduits, circuit boards visible through shell. Segmented at joints with energy lines. Subtle cyan glow. MANDATORY: Cyan (#00CED1) only, high detail on internal tech.

hud_monocle.name: HUD Monocle

description.overview: Mechanical-framed holographic display worn over right eye. Brass-colored frame with cyan holographic lens projection.
description.purpose: Threat detection, facial recognition, low-light vision, data overlay

frame.shape: Circular lens holder with temple attachment
frame.details: Small adjustment screws, micro-hinges, thin cables to temple

attachment.temple_piece: Wraps behind ear, contains power source

effects.active: Bright glow, visible HUD elements (targeting reticles, text)

views_needed.description: Monocle on face, profile showing attachment

hud_monocle.generation_prompt: Steampunk-cyberpunk monocle: Brass-framed circular lens with visible micro-gears. Cyan holographic projection in lens showing HUD elements. Temple piece wraps behind ear. MANDATORY: Brass (#B8860B) frame, Cyan (#00CED1) lens glow.

tactical_holotable.name: Tactical Holographic Table

description.overview: Large circular platform in Resistance HQ that projects 3D city maps and tactical data. Central command interface.
description.purpose: Mission planning, real-time tracking, tactical coordination

base.material: Dark metal with embedded projector array

projection.detail: Buildings, streets, marked locations, moving indicators

effects.active: City projection rotating slowly, data streams visible
effects.interaction: Areas highlight when touched, zoom capability

views_needed.description: Top-down showing circular shape and projection
From user standing at edge, projection visible

tactical_holotable.generation_prompt: Sci-fi holographic tactical table: Large circular dark metal platform projecting cyan 3D city map. Control ring around edge with status lights. Projection shows buildings, streets, moving markers. MANDATORY: Dark metal base, Cyan (#00CED1) holographic projection.

whiskey_glass.name: Whiskey Tumbler

description.overview: Classic rocks glass for whiskey. Thick glass bottom, worn from years of use. Charlie's frequent companion at The Signal.

contents.ice: Optional - usually none (Charlie drinks it neat)

lighting_interaction.reflection: Catches bar lighting, creates amber glow

views_needed.description: Glass on bar, amber liquid visible

whiskey_glass.generation_prompt: Noir film whiskey glass: Clear rocks glass with amber whiskey, 1/3 full. Heavy thick base. Worn from years of use. Bar lighting creates amber reflection. MANDATORY: Realistic glass material, amber liquid, noir lighting.

resistance_pistol.name: Standard Resistance Pistol

description.overview: Compact semi-automatic sidearm used by Resistance fighters. Matte black finish, no-nonsense design. Charlie's primary weapon.

condition.marks: Small scratches, one worn spot on grip

resistance_pistol.generation_prompt: Sci-fi tactical pistol: Compact semi-auto, matte black finish, angular futuristic design. Small cyan holographic sight. Well-used but maintained. MANDATORY: Matte black, minimal design, one cyan accent on sight only.

neon_sign_signal.name: The Signal Neon Sign

description.overview: Neon sign above Felix's bar. 'THE SIGNAL' in art deco font, cyan glow with occasional flicker.

neon_sign_signal.generation_prompt: Art deco neon sign: 'THE SIGNAL' in condensed art deco font, cyan neon tubes. Metal frame mounting, slightly weathered. Soft cyan glow around letters. MANDATORY: Cyan (#00CED1) only, art deco typography.

temple_spire.name: Temple Spire

description.overview: Towering spire of the Temple of ECHO. Art deco design reaching toward the sky, topped with glowing amber beacon. Visible from most of the city.

materials.windows: Narrow, vertical, amber glow from within

details.statues: Robed figures at base and mid-levels

temple_spire.generation_prompt: Art deco religious tower: Massive stepped pyramid spire, dark stone with gold/amber metal accents. Amber beacon at top. Narrow amber-lit windows. Geometric carvings, robed statues. MANDATORY: Dark stone, Gold/Amber (#FFD700) accents only, ominous atmosphere.

data_terminal.name: Public Data Terminal

description.overview: Public access computer terminal found throughout the city. Used for information, communication, and Temple surveillance.

screen.content: Menu interface, text prompts, Temple logo

data_terminal.generation_prompt: Cyberpunk street terminal: Standing kiosk with angled holographic screen showing cyan text. Mechanical keyboard at base. Metal pedestal, slightly worn. Small camera lens visible. MANDATORY: Dark metal, Cyan (#00CED1) screen glow.
